description: Longitudinal QOL + adherence + adverse event tracker. Cross-actor leg to yakushi pharma.adverseEventReport (individual + aggregated) per master charter §Decision 8. Patient-aggregated cohort statistics public, individual record encrypted (G2 + G7 + G10). Per ADR-2605260100 + ADR-2605260115 (SLIT cohort) + ADR-2605260175 (yakushi naphazoline closed-loop).

encryptedFollowupEnvelope.description: G2 mandatory. CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope containing: full QOL questionnaire response, adherence detail, AE narrative, patient feedback. Sealed-recipient = patient + Council medical advisory + licensed MD + (for yakushi cross-actor leg) yakushi pharma_post_market_surveillance recipient DID set.

qolScorePpm.description: Normalized QOL score in parts-per-million (0..1_000_000 maps to 0.0..1.0). Specific scale registered per followupType. Per ADR-2605190900 lexicon convention.

adherenceFractionPpm.description: Adherence fraction over last reporting window, in parts-per-million (0..1_000_000 maps to 0.0..1.0). Per ADR-2605190900 lexicon convention.

yakushiCrossActorRelation.description: Set when patient is consuming yakushi-distributed product and AE is signaled. Triggers downstream cross-actor leg per master charter §Decision 8.

yakushiLotIdHashed.description: SHA-256(lot_id) for dedupe key (joint mitate-yakushi R1 ADRs AE dedupe rule). Plaintext lot_id is in encryptedFollowupEnvelope only.

individualHandoffConsent.description: If true, mitate emits com.etzhayyim.pharma.adverseEventReport individual record to yakushi pharma_adverse_event. If false, only aggregated.

aggregatedFeedEnabled.description: Defaults true for yakushi-distributed product AE. G7 + G10 enforce no patient identity in aggregated feed.

naphazoleClosedLoopMarker.description: Set true for condition-5 rhinitis-medicamentosa followup involving yakushi naphazoline-hydrochloride. Triggers yakushi label warning data-driven update loop per ADR-2605260175 §Decision 4.
